hook.name: LunchTaxHookImmutable
hook.description: A non-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired token launches that collects configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 20% per side) via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, with optional launch guards including timestamp-based trading delays, decaying opening taxes, and per-transaction buy caps. Collected ETH is distributed to token creators and a platform address.
